maria-plat: Heads-up — planning to flip runtime kernel -> quant-v3 during Tue 00:30 UTC night window. Need ops + runtime signoff. Deploybot will do staged swap.
ajahn: staging canary baked? saw perf delta on short seqs?
maria-plat: yes, staging ran ~6h. 99p latency +4ms, p95 steady. throughput +1.2%. KV cache hit stable. small tail on ~2% hosts (2–3x p99).
chris: perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/runtime/perf?run=canary-173
leo-eng: tiny tail increase could be thermal related. suggest pinning affected hosts and running staged rollout.
maria-plat: agreed. plan: pin affected hosts (12) for 6h, then run deploy: 00:30 onboard, 01:00 ramp 30%, 01:30 ramp 100%. ops standby 00:00–03:00.
leo-eng: command: `/deploybot pin --hosts therm-rt-* --reason "quant-v3 tail" --ttl 6h`
deploybot: ✅ pinned 12 hosts matching therm-rt-*. TTL 6h. run_id=987654
sre-bot: noticed thermal sensors on those hosts above baseline at 02:14 UTC in staging. open ticket #INC-3012
ajahn: rollback criteria?
maria-plat: rollback if: p99 > 120ms for >5min OR error-rate > 0.3% sustained for 3min OR KV cache-miss spike > 8%.
chris: release notes blurb draft? can help with wording.
maria-plat: draft: "runtime: quant-v3 kernel — improved throughput and lower median latency; rolling canary revealed small p99 tail on subset; staged rollout with host pinning and thermal mitigations."
leo-eng: I'll add runbook snippet and ops checklist to RN.
chris: I'll open PR for RN + rollout script now.
maria-plat: ops, please monitor: latency by host, gpu_thermal, kv_cache_hit, and error-rate. notify #eng-oncall and #incidents on deviation.
